children: price target after the companys $10.2 billion equity raise raised doubts about AI spending.
Analyst Robin Zhu cut his target from $180 to $165 but maintained a Buy rating. He questioned the deals timing and optics, not Alibabas growth opportunity.
Alibaba held more than $30 billion in net cash before tapping shareholders. Investors questioned why equity was necessary and whether managements expected capital-spending returns were credible.
Alibaba combines a huge e-commerce business with Alicloud, its strategic cloud division. Management is spending aggressively on servers, proprietary processors and AI infrastructure.

Zhu increased his server-cost and rental-price assumptions while raising forecasts for non-AI cloud revenue. He valued Alibabas commerce and cloud businesses separately, cross-checking the result against 15 times next-year earnings.
Why Bernstein Still Rates Alibaba Stock a Buy
Cloud economics remain highly encouraging. Zhu estimates Alibabas Zhenwu 810E chip can repay its cost within three years, while feedback suggests the newer M890 chip could achieve a 2.5-year payback.
Higher server rental prices and tight capacity could accelerate Alicloud revenue while producing strong incremental margins. That explains why Bernstein remains bullish despite cutting its target.

The problem is funding. Reaching $100 billion in external cloud revenue by fiscal 2031 could require nearly RMB1 trillion of capital expenditure. Alibabas latest raise fills only part of that requirement and introduces dilution without eliminating future financing concerns.

Paradoxically, Zhu suggested a larger raise might have reassured investors by closing more of the gap. Instead, the current deal generated dilution while leaving uncertainty over future capital needs.

For shareholders, the decisive evidence will be faster cloud growth, improving utilization and visible returns from Alibabas custom chips. Until those appear, the lower target reflects execution and credibility risk rather than a rejection of the AI strategy.
Wall Street retains a Strong Buy consensus and an average $188.10 price target.

title: Bernstein Revamps Alibaba Stock Target After $10.2 Billion Raise
